releaseStatus.note: RAV 2.5.6 is the current public release. It adds ProRes 4444 and PNG/JPG image-sequence export, a GPU Canvas toggle, parse-once file inspection, and render-rate ViewModel readouts; legacy state-machine input controls and their two MCP tools are removed, for 55 tools total.

entities.name: RAV
entities.description: RAV is a desktop Rive animation viewer and exporter with timeline, still-image, animated-image, live interaction recording, bundled verified encoders, and MCP access.
